item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi dbang bzhi bskur ba'i rim pa las gsang dbang bde chen snying po
item.coloph: ces gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bde chen snying po 'di ni/ gsang don mchog la nges pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ 'ja' tshon snying pos shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams bon gyi 'dun ('dus) sa ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du/ me 'brug zla tshes la brtsam pa dge legs 'phel bar shog
